notes.title: v19.27 Update
notes.content:
- Improved both AIs
- Added more button spawn points
- Added an option to enable/disable collisions with other rats

notes.title: v19.21 Update
notes.content:
This update lets you spectate what's happening in the sewer through the monitor in multiplayer.
If you get eaten and respawn, you can now choose to spectate at spawn, or re-enter the sewer if the door has been opened by those still inside.

notes.title: v19 Update
notes.content:
Added 'Insane' difficulty
 Added difficulty selection to multiplayer
 Revamped UI system (monitor)
 Added a new volumetric audio system (realistic reverb, spatial sound, etc)
 Added different colors for your rat body (you can change it in the new settings menu)
 A bunch of small gameplay improvements and fixes

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Scamper Multiplayer is out now! 

You can go alone with multiple difficulty levels to choose from, or with other rats in multiplayer.
Featuring dynamic rat avatars, proximity voice chat, and more!

It is time to enter the sewer



Changelog:

 Added multiplayer mode
 Improved UI
 Improved AI and animation
 Numerous other improvements and fixes

notes.content:
